therapeutic_hypothesis.compound: Cobimetinib + Atezolizumab (BRAF wild-type) / Cobimetinib + Atezolizumab + Vemurafenib (BRAF V600 mutant)
therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: MEK inhibition + immune checkpoint blockade + BRAF inhibition (for mutant tumors)
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Tumor cell proliferation inhibition and immune system activation against melanoma brain metastases
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Metastatic melanoma patients with CNS metastases (BRAF wild-type and BRAF V600 mutation-positive)

results.effect_size: 46.4% intracranial ORR (95% CI: 32.99-60.26) in BRAF V600 mutant cohort
subgroup_findings: BRAF V600 mutant cohort (Cohort 2) showed better responses than BRAF wild-type cohort (Cohort 1)
Extracranial ORR: 56.9% vs 20.0% for mutant vs wild-type
Overall ORR: 52.3% vs 26.7% for mutant vs wild-type
Median overall PFS: 5.49 vs 1.81 months for mutant vs wild-type
safety_signals: Grade 3-5 adverse events common in both cohorts
Serious adverse events included pancytopenia, cardiac failure, myocarditis, retinal detachment
Grade 5 events (deaths) occurred in both cohorts
results.dose_information: Cobimetinib 60 mg daily days 1-21/28; Atezolizumab 840 mg IV days 1,15/28; Vemurafenib 960 mg BID cycle 1 then 720 mg BID thereafter

context.comparator: No control arm - single arm study
context.investigator_commentary: Sponsor discontinued enrollment into Cohort 1 (BRAF wild-type), suggesting limited efficacy in this population
